hero.headline: Hand-harvested on Aruba.
hero.subheading: Square crystals from the north coast, dried in the open air by sun and trade winds. Nothing boiled. Nothing added.

seaSalt.description: Hand-harvested finishing salt from Aruba's north coast, sun-dried in open air by the Caribbean sun and trade winds. Clean, bright, and gently crunchy. Pinch it on just before serving so the crystal stays intact.

bathSalt.description: Pure AruSalt sea salt for the bath, harvested and sun-dried in Aruba, then blended with Caribbean fragrance and color. The signature scent is Aruban Breeze. It dissolves smoothly and leaves the skin refreshed.
